description: De Soto 5-parameter single-diode + Faiman NOCT thermal + empirical OPV tempco correction. Based on non-fullerene acceptor (NFA) OPV module representative parameters.

module.name: OPV NFA module representative (PM6:Y6-type, n~1.7)
module.source: Kawano et al. (2006) J. Appl. Phys.; Zhang et al. (2018) Adv. Energy Mater.; Brabec et al. (2010) Adv. Mater.

area.note: Module active area (800 cm2 typical for commercial format)

alpha_sc.note: +0.12 mA/K; OPV Isc has slight positive tempco

gamma_pmp.note: -0.21%/K measured for PM6:Y6 NFA devices (Zhang et al. 2018)

NOCT.note: Lower NOCT than Si due to lightweight thin-film substrate

I_L_ref.note: Photocurrent at STC for 800cm2, 50 cells in series (Jsc ~7.25 mA/cm2)

I_o_ref.note: Saturation current; high for organic due to defect recombination

R_s.note: High series resistance due to low mobility organics

R_sh_ref.note: Moderate shunt resistance for morphological defects

EgRef.note: Effective charge-transfer state energy (lower than optical bandgap ~1.6eV)

dEgdT.note: Temperature coefficient of effective CT-state Eg

correction_factor.note: RATIONALE: OPV gamma_desoto_est=-0.30%/K vs measured -0.21%/K. Factor=0.70. Validated vs Kawano (2006) and Zhang (2018).
